title: Stage 1 Operator Review
description: SKILL.md §8, §9. Left blank by the agent; filled by the operator after reading the contract report. Renamed from 'independent_evaluation' — this is an operator-controlled certification boundary, not a second-model evaluation. See Regression Case 10 for the full truth table this schema's stage1_complete field must satisfy.

technical_status.description: System-assessed. Set by the semantic + evidence validators, not by the operator.

operator_disposition.description: Human-recorded. Null until the operator has actually reviewed the contract report.

stage1_complete.description: Derived, never set directly by the agent or the operator. Must equal: (operator_disposition == 'APPROVE') AND (technical_status in ['PASS','REVIEW']).
